say.speaker: smoliv
say.text: Y-you chased every single one of those raiders off! I thought I was done for...

say.speaker: healer
say.text: You are safe now! Were you traveling these mountain trails all alone?

say.speaker: smoliv
say.text: I was trying to reach the capital markets, but the roads have turned so dangerous... Please, {lord}, may I join your team? I feel the safest when I am with all of you!

say.speaker: lord
say.text: Of course you can, Smoliv! Stick with us and we will cross the mountain together.
